full_name: Two screening questions on reported visual disability from the Statistics Canada Health and Activity Limitations Survey (HALS); positive if at least one answered yes
domains: near (reading newsprint) and distance (face at 12 feet) task difficulty, with usual correction
scoring: NR (positive if >= 1 yes under Statistics Canada definition; alternatives: either item alone, both items)
notes: Question wording from Methods p2; asked in a home interview in the CSHA. Not otherwise validated in this paper beyond sens/spec/PPV/NPV vs presenting-VA categories
